article.body:
Title: ArXiv Paper Lists Study on Social Pain and Adolescent Brain-State Dynamics, but No Evidence Presented

An arXiv cs.AI record dated October 8, 2026, lists a paper titled "Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury." However, the available record provides no authors, abstract, methods, or study results. As such, it does not establish what evidence the paper presents or how its title's claim was assessed.

The paper's title suggests it investigates the impact of social pain on the brain dynamics of adolescents who engage in non-suicidal self-injury. However, the arXiv record does not provide any details about the research methods used, the participants involved, or the results obtained. Therefore, it is unclear whether the paper supports its title's claim that social pain disrupts emotion-action brain-state dynamics in this specific population.

The arXiv record can be found at this link: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11155](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11155)

This report is based on the provided intelligence record and does not speculate on the paper's findings or implications. Further research may be needed to determine whether the paper presents evidence to support its title's claim.
